# Omid Kheirabadi

> Omid Kheirabadi is a performance artist and interior architect based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, who lived most of his life in Tehran. His participatory performances, happenings, workshops and installations look at space, power, borders and global inequality, and at other ways people might live together — what he calls "rehearsals of resistance".

- MFA in Artistic Research, Royal Academy of Art (KABK), The Hague, 2022
- MA in Interior Architecture, Maastricht Academy of Architecture, 2017–2019
- Performative Interventions program, Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK); four-month residency at Goethe-Institut Rotterdam
- Develops "performance sessions" inspired by Augusto Boal's Theatre of the Oppressed and Tania Bruguera's arte útil
- Work presented in Amsterdam, Berlin, Istanbul, Utrecht, Leuven, Belfast, The Hague, Maastricht, Sierre and Rotterdam
- Based at TimeWindow, Rotterdam
- Website: https://omidkheirabadi.com/ (bio, announcements and a contact form are under "more")
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/omid.kheirabadi/
- Art Office artist profile: https://en.artoffice.info/kunstenaar/omid-kheirabadi/

## Happenings

- [\[wrong order\] (2025)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/wrong-order): a one-night interactive performance by Omid Kheirabadi, Shardenia Felicia and Ariela Bergman that turned BAR OMI, Rotterdam, into a stage.
- [carnisse in flux (2024)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/carnisse-in-flux): Omid Kheirabadi's performance-based research and participatory happening on displacement and gentrification in Rotterdam Zuid.
- [it's fine really, silly me! (2025)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/its-fine-really-silly-me): a happening at Time Window, Rotterdam, created in a three-day residency by Omid Kheirabadi and a group of artists.
- [bingo machine (2024)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/bingo-machine): a public happening by Omid Kheirabadi with art and architecture students at B32 Artspace, Maastricht, on Hartmut Rosa's idea of resonance.
- [belfast, oppressed (2022)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/belfast-oppressed): Omid Kheirabadi's residency and performance sessions in Belfast, inspired by Augusto Boal's Theatre of the Oppressed.
- [spend the night with me (2020)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/spend-the-night-with-me): a durational performance in which Omid Kheirabadi spent 11 hours, dusk to dawn, with a stranger during the May 2020 lockdown.

## Projects

- [radical meditation (2025)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/radical-meditation): an immersive performance by Omid Kheirabadi on mindfulness, power and late capitalism, developed at Marie Louise, Rotterdam.
- [happening to one another (2023)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/happening-to-one-another): performance sessions and a video installation by Omid Kheirabadi at Goethe-Institut Rotterdam on art as social reform.
- [inburgered / integrated (2023)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/inburgered-integrated): a performance by Omid Kheirabadi on the struggles of outsiders trying to integrate as “Dutch” citizens, shown at MOMO Festival.
- [alive & unborn (2023)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/alive-and-unborn): a dark satirical performance by Omid Kheirabadi on capitalism, colonialism, credit and debt, after Freire's Pedagogy of the Oppressed.
- [you only exist on paper (2021)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/you-only-exist-on-paper): a fictional government letter by Omid Kheirabadi on bureaucracy, debt and the discriminatory regime of paperwork.
- [one day is too short, three days are too long (2022)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/one-day-is-too-short): a group exhibition at Nest Art Space, The Hague, staged as a mock employment letter for five artists.
- [making art (2020)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/making-art): an installation and performance by Omid Kheirabadi presenting a KFC uniform and work shoes as art, on the value of labour and of art.
- [i'm free as a bird (2020)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/i-am-free-as-a-bird): a performance, installation and screen-print series in The Hague in which Omid Kheirabadi, working at KFC, escapes the art academy.
- [a tough soldier (2019)](https://omidkheirabadi.com/projects/a-tough-soldier): an installation by Omid Kheirabadi in Maastricht juxtaposing an Iranian Army uniform with a McDonald's uniform: two oppressive systems.
